hunks.baseline: He had said that changing one’s position changed the view one could see. Behind the Peak wall I had barely crossed, a rugged mountain range was waiting.
hunks.sol: They say that when the position you stand in changes, the scenery you see changes too. Behind the Peak wall I had barely crossed, a rugged mountain range was waiting.

hunks.baseline: “Because I’m grateful. That’s all.”
hunks.sol: “Because I’m grateful. Grateful.”

hunks.baseline: But I had been lucky. Cheongpung had devoted nearly ten days to helping me train, and he had even passed on the Sword Saint’s teachings.
hunks.sol: But I had been lucky. Cheongpung had wholeheartedly helped me train for nearly ten days, and he had even passed on the Sword Saint’s teachings.

hunks.baseline: Cheongpung looked around with lost eyes, then spotted Hyuk Mujin snoring in the corner of the training ground and shouted.
hunks.sol: Cheongpung looked around like he’d lost his way, then spotted Hyuk Mujin snoring in the corner of the training ground and shouted.

hunks.baseline: This was genuinely pathetic.
hunks.sol: Pitiful. Truly pitiful.

hunks.baseline: I stared at him, saliva stains covering the area around his mouth, and quietly spoke.
hunks.sol: I stared at the guy with drool all around his mouth and quietly spoke.

hunks.baseline: “…You heard me?”
hunks.sol: “…You heard that?”

hunks.baseline: But I wanted to continue sparring with Cheongpung even more.
hunks.sol: But I wanted to continue the duel with Cheongpung even more.

hunks.baseline: People saw only as much as they knew. After reaching the Peak realm, I realized once again just how much of a monster Cheongpung was.
hunks.sol: People see only as much as they know. After reaching the Peak realm, I realized once again just how much of a monster Cheongpung was.

hunks.baseline: But that was not what I wanted. Winning a duel against an opponent who was not giving his all would only leave a bitter taste.
hunks.sol: But that was not what I wanted. Winning a duel against an opponent who was not giving his all would only leave me feeling hollow.

hunks.baseline: I watched Cheongpung’s back recede for a long time before returning to the pavilion.
hunks.sol: I watched Cheongpung’s retreating figure for a long while before returning to the pavilion.

hunks.baseline: Someone might think that was stingy, but not me.
hunks.sol: Someone might think that was stingy, but it was anything but.

hunks.baseline: I was already satisfied that the realms of Jin Family’s Cultivation Technique and Qi Sense, which had stagnated for so long, had risen. Gaining two more Levels on top of that was an entirely separate stroke of luck.
hunks.sol: I was already satisfied that the realms of Jin Family’s Cultivation Technique and Qi Sense, which had stagnated for so long, had risen. Gaining Levels on top of that made it a double blessing.

hunks.baseline: The place where a great ruler had founded a powerful nomadic empire long ago had changed with the passage of time.
hunks.sol: The place where a great ruler had founded a nomadic empire long ago had changed with the passage of time.

hunks.baseline: The customs of the nomads still remained, but the clothing and culture of the Central Plains were slowly infiltrating the plateau.
hunks.sol: The customs of the nomads still remained, but the reality was that the clothing and culture of the Central Plains were slowly infiltrating the plateau.

hunks.baseline: Unlike the middle-aged man who welcomed them with both arms spread wide, the other man did not even dip his head. He merely gestured.
hunks.sol: Unlike the middle-aged man who welcomed them with both arms spread wide, the other man did not so much as nod. He merely gestured.

hunks.baseline: Temur had always been hot-tempered and reckless. Before Chinggen had time to stop him, his hand seized the curved saber at his waist.
hunks.sol: Temur had always been hot-tempered and reckless. Before Chinggen had time to stop him, his hand snatched at the curved saber.

hunks.baseline: “Sit down.”
hunks.sol: “I said sit.”

hunks.baseline: Taking advantage of the moment, Chinggen hurriedly grabbed Temur by the shoulder. He did not forget to whisper in a voice barely loud enough to hear.
hunks.sol: Taking advantage of the moment, Chinggen hurriedly grabbed Temur by the shoulder. He did not forget to whisper in a barely audible voice.

hunks.baseline: Four people had gathered here today. They had never met before, but each was a powerhouse who held up one of the major forces of Northern Gaoyuan.
hunks.sol: Four people had gathered here today. They had never met before, but each was a powerhouse who held up one pillar of Northern Gaoyuan.

hunks.baseline: He was Han Chinese, and he had ridden across the steppe with only fifty subordinates. He had earned the nickname Human Butcher because he killed people as though slaughtering livestock.
hunks.sol: He was Han Chinese, and with only fifty subordinates, he had dominated the steppe. He had earned the nickname Human Butcher because he killed people as though slaughtering livestock.

hunks.baseline: “You’re a slow one, friend.”
hunks.sol: “You’re slow to catch on, friend.”
